Cancer Outcomes
=============

The Cancer Outcomes module tracks disease-specific outcomes related to a particular diagnosis.

Data Collection Fields
--------------------

Outcome Information
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Diagnosis Link**: The diagnosis this outcome is associated with
* **Date Assessed**: When the outcome was evaluated
* **Outcome Type**: Nature of the outcome (e.g., Local Recurrence, Nodal Recurrence)

Documentation
^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Associated DICOM Studies**: Imaging studies confirming the outcome

Special Considerations
--------------------

1. Assessment Documentation:

   #. Record timing of assessments  
   #. Document basis for outcome determination  
   #. Note any uncertainty in assessment  

2. Follow-up:

   #. Track outcomes systematically  
   #. Document supporting evidence  
   #. Note impact on subsequent treatment
